name: AV1 trellis off

name: AV1 trellis end-of-block gate
what: Gate the AV1 trellis by end-of-block position.

name: AV1 trellis SVT greedy limits

name: AV1 linear rate for transform-split trial
what: Price the AV1 transform-split trial with a linear coefficient rate.

name: AV1 precomputed coefficient context walk
what: Precompute the AV1 coefficient context walk (exact).
reason: exact but slower on c8a; trellis inner-loop micro-edits also gave more instructions

name: AV1 frame-level loop-filter gate
what: Frame-level gate (filter.*): deblocking off on non-base frames after a 75%-skipped reference; CDEF reuse on well-predicted frames by a frame proxy.

name: AV1 per-block CDEF skip on static content
what: Leave 64x64 blocks whose zero-vector SAD vs previous source is under t quantizer steps out of CDEF (third strength set all off).
reason: AV1 Faster: t=0.05 +0.8..+1.9% bytes, -0.03..-0.18 dB for -4.7% P-frame Ir; t=0.1 -5.6% Ir for +0.8..+3.2% bytes; more than the M12-M10 slope

name: VVC key-frame speed bundle
what: VVC key-frame speed bundle.
reason: passed pool screen but failed the 10 s key pulse guard on static clips (rate control's second-key budget)

name: HEVC Fast Default depth params-only and quantizer gate
what: Re-point HEVC Fast to the Default's depth settings (parameters only), or gate depth removal by quantizer (planner.depth_removal_min_quantizer 0.84/0.78/0.70).

name: HEVC Fast light superblocks (regular_fraction)
what: Regular superblocks with Default depth+transform tree, light ones with Fast's, by effort.regular_fraction; on old and new HEVC Fast, optionally Faster's motion values.
reason: old Fast rf 0.25 CBR L3 +0.59% [+0.14,+1.04] WORSE; on new Fast every light trade costs 0.58-0.96 W points per 1% speed, 3-4x the SVT line's 0.22

name: HEVC Faster base with Default depth and transform tree
what: HEVC Faster base with the Default's depth and transform tree everywhere (also light shares 0.5/0.25).
reason: lens +1.7/-6.6 (Faster +17.4/+4.8) at -7..-11% Ir vs Fast; CBR quality +7.4% full vs Fast, L3 J +1.06% WORSE, quality and key-pulse guards

name: AVX-512 border stores without non-temporal hint
what: Picture border writes use ordinary stores instead of non-temporal ones (AVX-512 tier first, every tier since ffb012fdc).
reason: c8a A/B AV1 Faster 819.8 -> 847.6 fps (+3.4%); AVX2 re-measure Zen 3 -0.3..-0.6%, Zen 5 -3.2% HEVC / -4.0% AV1

name: AV1 CDEF uses backend Dsp
what: AV1 CDEF entry points take the backend's Dsp instead of building a new Dsp five times a frame (exact).
reason: callgrind Faster -0.03%, Fast -0.03%, Default -0.06%; with border stores c8a 810.6 -> 845.2 fps

name: AV1 key CfL slope search on shared cfl_sse kernel
what: Key-frame CfL slope search runs on a shared nc-dsp CfL prediction-SSE kernel (Dsp::cfl_sse; AVX2, NEON, SIMD128).
reason: lowlight Default key frame 2072M -> 1922M Ir (-7.2%); Jetson all-key Default cycles -5.15%, CBR 600 -1.74%

name: AV1 CDEF coded-unit map and band driver
what: AV1 CDEF finds its units from a coded-unit map filled by the block writer (shared CdefMap) and reused frames filter through the decoder's band driver.
reason: lowlight q184 Faster: CDEF 3.46M -> 2.78M per P frame, P frame -2.2%; key frame +0.9M

name: Kernel-sharing merges to wide tiers
what: Merge per-codec kernels into shared nc-dsp families with 256/512-bit tiers (feature/kernel-share).

name: HEVC Fast re-point to Default depth and transform tree
what: HEVC Fast takes the Default's depth removal (thresholds 0) and inter transform tree plus Faster's CBR-harmless settings (inter rounding 85, SAO chroma off, partial forward zero scales 3/4).
reason: CBR L3 J -1.31% [-2.17,-0.48] BETTER; final-check -2.93% (pulse guard at limit, kept on judgement); lens W +7.9 -> -3.1

name: HEVC Fast + Default merge candidates
what: Add the Default's merge-candidate group to the new HEVC Fast.
reason: lens -3.1 -> -4.3 W at +3.5% c8a time, CBR L1 quality -2.3%, but final-check WORSE on key pulse (meva_admin +1.98 dB, J +10.3%)

name: HEVC Fast + Default structure group
what: Add the Default's structure group to the new HEVC Fast (lens ablation).
reason: lens -4.3 W at +4.3% Ir (0.28 points per 1%, above the 0.22 line); no further screen stated

name: HEVC Fast + Default motion, trellis or intra groups
what: Add the Default's motion levers, trellis or intra bundle to the new HEVC Fast (lens ablation).
reason: motion -6.3 at +18% (0.17/1%), trellis -4.5 at +31% (0.05), intra -6.0 at +41% (0.07): below the line's 0.22 rate

name: Shared quantizer work gates (WorkGate)
what: Shared nc_encoder GateInput/GateParams/WorkGate: cheap path from a relative quantizer up, or where error per sample < max_energy steps^2; AV1 Fast depth+partial forward gated at 0.78/0.86.
reason: infrastructure landed 6d4d2c636 (streams identical); gates 0.78 on new Fast final-check J +1.10% [+0.81,+1.40] WORSE, bd_worst_vmaf_v1 +3.47 (150 f screen had said equal)

name: AV1 Fast re-point to Default depth and full forward
what: AV1 Fast with the Default's depth removal and full forward transform (RF).
reason: diagnosis: 250 fps -6.5 W vs Fast 306 fps +1.6; landed: CBR L3 J -3.95%

name: AV1 Fast transform-split trial gated by quantizer
what: RF + transform-split trial below gate 0.7 with av1.inter_tx_split_energy 1.
reason: lens -7.7 W at 231-262 fps; CBR J -3.97% vs Fast but rate overshoot on 5 rungs and flicker +0.07 guards

name: AV1 Fast + deblocking + split trial
what: RF plus deblocking plus gated transform-split trial.
reason: lens -10.4 W at 231 fps; CBR J -2.99% vs RF but WORSE on periodic-key pulse (+1.00 dB) and ceiling (+1.69%)

name: AV1 Fast re-point key-side pulse fixes
what: Fix the re-pointed Fast's key pulse on the key side: Default key intra set or rate.key_still_boost 2/3/6.

name: AV1 partial-transform energy gate
what: Partial forward transform where the residual is under e squared steps per sample, per transform.

name: Rate refine_cost for base frames

name: Rate key-dip bound
what: rate.key_dip: hold P-frame PSNR-Y within N dB of the expected key.
reason: final-check vs old Fast at 4 dB: J -6.47%, worst pulse +1.02 dB, hospital 300 kbps 37% under target; deleted

name: Rate measured pre-key quiet run-up

name: AV1 Fast + Default cheap quality groups

what: AV1 Default takes exact_rank_margin 0, cdef_search_row_step 1 and keyframe_cfl 1 from Slow.

name: AV1 Default trellis off or Fast key intra set

reason: CBR L1 +1.14% / +3.93%: no Default re-mix reaches M10's speed at its Weighted

name: AV1 light pipeline per-superblock budget on Default
what: SVT-style light pipeline (S1/S2): effort.regular_fraction gives the expensive path to a share of superblocks on a Default base; tune front points t33/t42/t59.
reason: lens rf 0.75 +0.38% BD at 0.98x, 0.5 +0.97% at 0.97x, 0.25 +3.65% at 0.90x, 0 +11.1% at 0.78x; tops out at 200 fps; tune points below Fast->Default line

name: AV1 absolute depth removal at 0.5 steps

reason: +11.4% BD: a bad trade

name: AV1 key-frame superblock budget (key_regular_fraction)

name: AV1 writer 64-bit range coder and level maps

name: Rate-validity rule for CBR points
what: Point invalid if it breaks the 1 s leaky bucket (peak > 1.5x) or overshoots by > 10% + buffer/window (key loan excluded); ours-vs-ours comparisons drop such rungs from both arms and count compliance

name: static_cam22 in CPU cost clips with geometric-mean cost
what: tune.COST_CLIPS gains static_cam22; cost is the geometric mean of per-clip instructions per P/key frame so each clip weighs equally in percent
reason: Static-only CPU levers got no credit before (L1T2 gate: -9% on cam22, 0 on moving clips); static P frames cost ~half of crowd ones

name: Chart low rungs on low-overlap clips (LOW_LADDER_KBPS 40/75)

name: Chart: chain unscored clips / drop unscored clips / higher anchor rungs

name: Paired x86 chart timing against x264 medium
what: Each point pinned to one logical CPU and paired with x264 medium on the same CPU in interleaved rounds, minimum of 5 per clip, so shared-machine load cancels
reason: Used for bd-vs-speed-x86 chart; no accuracy number stated

name: Reuse one Jetson anchor timing across points
what: Jetson core 3 is clock-locked and x264 medium repeats within ~0.3 ms/frame, so time --anchor-from reuses one fresh anchor timing instead of re-timing per point
reason: x264 medium repeats within ~0.3 ms/frame across lock windows; used for the last five points at 21e57063

name: Per-family chart refresh tool (chart_refresh.py)
what: Refresh only the families a commit changes, each on its own recorded build; overlap Jetson build, measure, scan and timing; reuse builds/plan entries for unchanged crates
reason: One-family refresh costs about the x86 build plus the measure; render reproduces chart5 CSVs byte for byte

name: Sanity report (ordering, outliers, tool activity, decay checks)
what: nceval sanity: ordering, outliers, per-codec tool activity (aom-inspect, libavcodec mb_type), key-frame size, per-frame decay vs reference, harness checks; single-keyframe sweeps
reason: Found AV1 bodycam_airport decay -0.028 dB/frame vs SVT -0.016, AV1 keys ~3.4x SVT size, CDEF strength 2-4 vs SVT 10-15, stale long.json with camera cuts

name: AV1 CDEF fix for per-frame quality decay

reason: bodycam_airport Y-PSNR decay -0.028 -> -0.0155 dB/frame (SVT -0.016)

name: Streamed point engine (no YUV files)
what: Encoder --recon /dev/fd/N into per-frame hash and streaming metric sinks, decoders piped to MD5 readers over anonymous pipes; no video file written; tune/sweep/fastbd ported
reason: 720p 150 f point: wall 92-126 s -> 4.6-6.9 s, peak RSS 591 -> 185 MB, bytes written 2.70 GB -> 1.4-2.1 MB; results byte-identical

name: Machine-wide CPU slots (flock slot files)
what: flock'd slot files, all-or-nothing, memory floor; slots taken before a point spawns its metric processes, per-process cap max(2, pool/4) then pool/2; nice 19, 16 slots
reason: pool/4 cap had made screens serial (one point per process), raised to pool/2 on 2026-11-11

name: VMAFx CUDA as default VMAF v1 + MS-SSIM backend
what: NC_METRICS_BACKEND vmafx-cuda: one VMAFx process per point computes VMAF v1 and MS-SSIM on the GPU, PSNR stays numpy; no fallback, self-check per process; GPU slots
reason: Parity 24/24 VMAF v1 identical to libvmaf 3.2.1, MS-SSIM within 2.2e-6; 1.86 s / 2.21 CPU-s vs libvmaf 1.97 s / 3.96 CPU-s + MS-SSIM 26.5 CPU-s

name: VMAFx frame-0 init race patch

name: libvmaf CUDA build for VMAF v1

reason: Display protocol numbers identical under its old namespace; no other measurement stated

name: Gate policy and verified-stream cache
what: --gate full|sample, verified-stream cache keyed by bitstream, gate level stored per result
reason: No numbers stated

name: Shared-cache entry locks (get_or_create)
what: Private temporaries, atomic cache writes, flock per cache entry so a second requester waits and reuses the point
reason: Fixed spurious conformance failures and missing files when two agents needed one shared anchor point

name: Encoder-side SSE log for ungated points
what: CLI logs per-plane SSE against the reference (--sse-log) and writes --display-recon straight into VMAFx stdin; Python never touches pixels for ungated points
reason: Python reader 0.5 -> 0.01 CPU-s per 720p 150-frame point; PSNR bit-identical

name: Decoder stream analysis behind a Cargo feature
what: StreamStats block records (HEVC, H.264, AV1, AV2, VP9, VVC) compiled only with the analysis feature; alternatives were a runtime test at every parse point and a const-flag monomorphised parser
reason: Runtime test cost +0.3% HEVC / +0.2% H.264 decode instructions; const-flag monomorphisation +1.2% (lost inlining); feature-gated is free when off

name: Separate browser analysis module (pkg/analysis)

name: Browser per-block PSNR map

name: Browser MS-SSIM in a metrics worker
what: nc_dsp::ms_ssim (scalar Rust, matches msssim.py to 1e-5) run in a per-view metrics worker at most once a second with analysis on

name: VMAFx MS-SSIM per-scale sums on the device
what: Patch 0002: float_ms_ssim per-scale term sums on the GPU in fixed order instead of reading 24 MB/frame back to the host
reason: MS-SSIM 5.7 s -> 2.1 s per 300 frames, 4.4 -> 1.0 CPU-s; values identical on 36 streams

name: VMAFx scoring server (--serve / --via-server)

reason: nceval 150-frame point alone 4.6 s -> 0.85 s; 8 points at once 127 -> 414 fps; 16 points 550 fps; scores bit-identical

name: VMAFx raw yuv read straight into picture
what: Patch 0005: CLI reads raw .yuv straight into the picture, one host copy per frame less
reason: User CPU 0.90 -> 0.52 s per 300 frames

name: VMAFx wider ADM and CAMBI kernel launches

name: VMAFx bounded server pool with memory gate

reason: After two GPU-full incidents (32 of 32.6 GB, 4-6 GB per orphaned server): <= ~4 GB per server, <= 12 GB pool

name: VMAFx descriptor-passed inputs, heartbeats and stall timeouts

name: VMAFx server generations (one-way drain)

name: VMAFx per-frame CUDA graphs

reason: 32 concurrent runs with 8 servers reached 945-1646 fps (noisy), ~2-3x; machine-wide state, left off

name: XPSNR extractor in VMAFx (CPU and CUDA)

name: Reuse AV2 adjacent motion-grid cells
what: Use the adjacent cells for the coding-order check, mode context and ordered candidate scan in both reference builders.
reason: AV2 Faster exact. Zen 5 -0.134% instructions and +0.237% cycles. Jetson -0.005% instructions and +0.515% cycles.

name: Batch extra full-pel motion positions
what: Evaluate ordered neighbors and mixed-motion positions through the full-pel window four-position SAD kernel.
reason: AV2 Faster exact. Zen 5 -0.166% instructions and +0.168% cycles. Jetson +0.167% instructions and -0.567% cycles.

name: Reuse AV2 zero-residual key-planner SSE
what: Measure prediction SSE directly for zero-residual key trials and keep exact reconstructed SSE for the other trials.
reason: AV2 Faster exact. Zen 5 -0.034% instructions and -0.393% cycles. Jetson -0.001% instructions and +0.060% cycles.

change: AV2 retained extra full-pel batches and key SSE

name: Packed AV2 coefficient replay records
what: Pack rounded Q12 CDF edges and common bypass literals into 32-bit replay records.
reason: Four Zen 5 Faster points were byte-identical. Retired instructions changed -0.01% to +0.02% and cycles -0.29% to +1.50% in a single-link screen.

name: More aggressive AV2 Faster base-frame zero test
what: Raise the zero-residual texture scale from 4 to 6 or 8 on base frames. Compare with the fallback disabled at scale 0.
reason: Scale 8 changed Zen 5 cycles -1.00% to +0.57%, IVF bytes -0.46% to -0.04%, and luma PSNR -0.084 to +0.002 dB. Scale 6 was also mixed. Retain scale 4.

name: Shared byte-dot interpolation rows
what: Share byte-window geometry and dot-product rows across AV1, AV2, HEVC, VVC and VP9 while retaining VP9 per-pass byte clipping.
reason: 306/306 exact. Zen 5 cycles -0.05% to +0.29% for five presets. Jetson AV1/VP9/HEVC/VVC +0.65/+1.18/-0.03/+0.40%.

name: Packed H.264 CABAC total counter
what: Index bin cost by the packed context state and bin. Use a single total for macroblock prices and batch frozen unary decisions.
reason: 306/306 exact. 17.4% fewer Ir per mb_bits call; Zen 5 instructions -0.35/-1.28% on Johnny/WestWindEasy and Jetson Johnny cycles -2.71%.

name: Fused H.264 8x8 luma transform and quantiser
what: Quantise the forward column-pass vectors and count nonzero levels before storing. Remove redundant clamps under the existing 8-bit range.
reason: 306/306 exact and 4.1% fewer transform/quantiser Ir. Four Zen 5 layouts all slowed on Johnny, +1.17% median cycles; WestWindEasy +0.22%. Jetson Johnny flat.
